additional_info.subject: RE: 0382228 - Proactive - ID0382228-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / RN 313392372010] Failsafe Mode Active CRM:00658000755
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Charger is not able to establish connection between SECC and DC1, and we have error flag related to cable related on DC1 as well.
Please plan a site visit for this and perform below mentioned activity.
Check 24V supply to KF12
Check connection of DC1 with KF12 at XD10.
Check connection of XD100 with State Monitor at XD10 and at J4 terminal 3 & 4
Check resistance between N1 and N2 & P1 and P2.
Let us know the results for further troubleshooting.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav
